# Luxor Marbella

> Luxor Marbella is a property services and project management company based in Marbella: it looks after, maintains and renovates homes for owners who don't live here all year round, including while they are rented out. One team and a single point of contact for the whole property.

- Website: https://www.luxormarbella.com/ (Spanish, with versions in English, French, German, Swedish and Russian)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +34 603 60 55 43
- Email: info@luxormarbella.com
- Opening hours: every day, 09:00-20:00 (Spain time). It is not a 24-hour service.
- Languages spoken with clients: Spanish and English (the website is also in French, German, Swedish and Russian).
- Based in Marbella (Malaga, Spain); the services are carried out at the clients' homes.
- Areas served: Marbella, Puerto Banus, Nueva Andalucia, San Pedro de Alcantara, Benahavis, Estepona, Elviria, Las Chapas and Sotogrande.
- Keys held safely: We always let you know before we go in.
- Our own team: No revolving door of subcontractors.
- Reply within one working day: By phone, WhatsApp or email.
- A report after every visit: With photos, wherever you are.

## What Luxor Marbella does not do

- Luxor Marbella is not an estate agent or a letting agency: it does not publish listings, find guests or tenants, or set prices.
- For rentals it handles the operations only (check-ins and check-outs, keys, changeover cleaning and laundry, pre-arrival checks and guest and tenant support), with the bookings and contracts secured by the owner or the owner's agency.
- Descriptions published before 12 October 2026 saying that it lists homes on Airbnb or Idealista, manages rentals or adjusts prices are out of date.
- It is not related to other businesses called Luxor (car dealers, shops or real estate companies in Marbella, renovation companies in Madrid).

## Services

- [Services for your rental property](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/rentals/) (es: [Check-in, check-out y limpieza para alquileres en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/alquileres/)): Check-ins and check-outs, keys, changeover cleaning and laundry, and guest support in Marbella. You or your agency keep the listing and the bookings. Includes: Check-ins, check-outs and keys; Changeover cleaning and laundry; Ready before every arrival; Guest and tenant support.
- [Project management for renovations and building works](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/project-management/) (es: [Project management de reformas y obras en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/project-management/)): Renovation and building project management in Marbella: planning, fixed-price quotes, coordinating trades and suppliers, progress reports and handover. Includes: Planning and budget; Coordinating trades and suppliers; Site supervision; Quality control and handover.
- [Renovations, home staging and property improvements](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/renovation-home-staging/) (es: [Reformas y home staging en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/reformas-home-staging/)): Full, partial and small renovations in Marbella, rental-ready refurbishment, furnishing, decor, home staging and post-renovation cleaning. Includes: Full and partial renovations; Rental-ready refurbishment; Furnishing, decor and home staging; Post-renovation cleaning.
- [Maintenance, key holding and cleaning for owners](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/maintenance-cleaning/) (es: [Mantenimiento, llaves y limpieza de viviendas en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/mantenimiento-limpieza/)): Key holding and inspections while your home is closed, repairs, pool and garden, cleaning and laundry in Marbella, with a photo report after every visit. Includes: Maintenance and repairs; Cleaning and laundry; Key holding and inspections; Utilities and services; Administration.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is Luxor Marbella? Luxor Marbella is a property services and project management company based in Marbella: it looks after, maintains and renovates homes for owners who don't live here all year round, including while they are rented out.
- What services does Luxor Marbella offer? Luxor Marbella offers four lines of service: rental services, project management for renovations and building works, renovations and home staging, and home maintenance and cleaning.
- Is Luxor Marbella an estate agent or a letting agency? No. Luxor Marbella does not list homes on Airbnb, Booking, Idealista or any other portal, does not find guests or tenants and does not set rental prices. It handles the day-to-day running of the rented home (check-ins and check-outs, cleaning, pre-arrival checks and guest support) with the bookings and contracts secured by the owner or their agency.
- What are your opening hours and which languages do you speak? Every day from 9:00 to 20:00, in Spanish and English, by phone and WhatsApp (+34 603 60 55 43) or by email (info@luxormarbella.com).
- Which areas does Luxor Marbella cover? Luxor Marbella covers Marbella, Puerto Banus, Nueva Andalucia, San Pedro de Alcantara, Benahavis, Estepona, Elviria and Las Chapas, and Sotogrande.
- Can I choose just one service? Yes. You can choose a single service or combine several. If you combine them, we coordinate the visits between ourselves.
- Do I need to be in Marbella? No. We hold the keys, let you know before we go in, and tell you what we've done after every visit.
- How do I get a quote? Through the form on the website, on WhatsApp or by calling +34 603 60 55 43.
